HOW TO HUNT

Build a deadly hand.

Choose cards in order. You can queue up to five tactical slots. Matching recruit cards stack in one slot (up to three). Click a queued card to remove its last card.

Build links. Same school, same rank, or a rank exactly one higher creates links. Hunger cards work as wild bridges, and special three-card rituals activate automatically.

Your hand. Begin with five different tactical roles. Keep cards you do not play. Draw one new card each turn and earn two more for every invader defeated, including poison and creature kills. Cards you cannot hold are banked until room opens.

Attack. Your command chain resolves before summoned minions and permanent defenders strike. Read enemy intent and use your target or summon lane to prepare. Killing an invader increases Hunger; finish with Gnaw or Devour to capture a trait.

Discard. Select Discard, then click an unwanted card. This redraws only that card. Gold buys new commands and upgrades between raids.

Keys: 1–8 play a card · Enter attack · R toggle discard · Escape clear combo · ? help.
